summary: An inbound or outbound webhook: signature verified with a replay window, claim-mark-release idempotency, tenant bound before any write, contract doc in the same PR.

required_inputs.name: direction
required_inputs.description: Inbound handler, outbound emitter, or both

required_inputs.name: provider_or_consumer
required_inputs.description: Who signs or who receives, and the signature scheme

required_inputs.name: event_types
required_inputs.description: The event names handled or emitted

required_inputs.name: tenant_resolution
required_inputs.description: How the tenant is found from the delivery before any write

checklist.rule: The signature is verified against every configured secret before the body is parsed, with a timestamp replay window
checklist.because: Flex verifies against both platform and tenant secrets; r3cruit3r Stripe webhook verification is a sensitive path because a bypass grants access

checklist.rule: Every handler is wrapped in claim, mark, release on the delivery id so a redelivery is a no-op and a crash releases the claim
checklist.because: Flex claimWebhookEvent exists because Stripe redelivers; LINDA webhook queue drains hourly and a duplicate event double-fired a graph

checklist.rule: The tenant is bound from the delivery's trusted identifiers before any write; correlation lookups stay in the bootstrap set
checklist.because: LINDA AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES allow the pre-tenant correlation read and nothing else; bind_tenant_async precedes writes

checklist.rule: The webhook path is excluded from tenant-routing middleware and any CSRF or session guard
checklist.because: Flex api/webhooks is excluded from the proxy matcher; a tenant firewall 404 on a provider callback drops payments silently

checklist.rule: An outbound event is registered in the event registry with the standard envelope and a dedupe key per delivery
checklist.because: LINDA docs/webhooks.md is code under test_integration_contract_docs; Flex-LINDA sequences broke when an envelope field was renamed

checklist.rule: The contract doc changes in the same PR as the wire format
checklist.because: LINDA test_integration_contract_docs fails the build otherwise; the doc is the consumer's only spec

checklist.rule: An unknown event type is acknowledged and logged, never processed by a default branch; a missing secret fails closed
checklist.because: A default branch that treats unknown events as the common case has granted access on unverified events

checklist.rule: The done output carries a consumer-impact note for the other side of the contract
checklist.because: Flex and LINDA each consume the other's events; a change with no note reached the consumer as a 4xx in production

checklist.rule: Test fixtures sign with a test secret from the environment, never a literal that looks real
checklist.because: The detect-secrets pre-commit and the ship-check secret grep both flag whsec_ literals

done_output: signature verification line quoted with the replay window
the claim, mark, release calls quoted
event types handled or emitted with the registry entry
stop_conditions: tenant cannot be resolved from the delivery
the path is inside a sensitive billing file without a grant
the contract doc does not exist and the task does not create it
